justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Adherence improvement translates to better functional outcomes; direct MI-on-clinical-outcomes evidence is indirect but consistent.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-3 day workshop standard; low-moderate cost; widely available online and in-person.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to virtually every patient encounter; behavior change is relevant across all diagnoses and settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No MI-specific billing code; billed as component of counseling or health coaching services; billing value is incidental.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Frequently valued in behavioral health, primary care rehab, and chronic disease settings; growing recognition in PT/OT.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Patients report feeling heard and autonomous; reduces resistance to therapy.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Consumers don't seek out an MI-certified provider; it's a communication skill, not a sellable service line.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: No premium pricing; invisible to patients and won't justify higher rates.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Common across behavioral health and increasingly rehab; minimal defensibility.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Can train staff to deliver consistent patient engagement, improving adherence and outcomes; modest systems value.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Low DTC recognition; patients don't search for MI.
justifications.business.efficiency: Short courses widely available, often under $500 and a weekend.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Valued as a teachable competency aligned with biopsychosocial care, but not a tenure-mover.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Robust literature in behavior change, adherence, chronic disease; supports research lines.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Highly relevant to DPT/OT curricula on patient communication, behavior change, chronic care.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Decades of RCT and meta-analytic evidence across substance use, chronic disease, rehab adherence.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally listed as preferred for behavioral/health-promotion teaching lines.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Cheap, fast, easily embedded into faculty development.
